items.title: Upstash Redis vs Cloudflare KV: Features, Performance & Pricing in 2026 | Upstash Blog
items.summary: Cloudflare KV and Upstash Redis are both used for caching and storing data, but they differ in their approach and performance. Cloudflare KV is a caching layer that stores data in a distributed database, while Upstash Redis is a Redis instance that can be used as a caching layer. Cloudflare KV is optimized for high availability and consistency, but can be slower than Upstash Redis due to its heavy caching and eventual consistency. Upstash Redis is faster and more flexible, but may not be suitable for all use cases. Choose Upstash Redis when you need a caching layer that works well within the Cloudflare ecosystem.
